premise: Snail wants to thank Bird for his song, but Bird's branch is far too high to climb; tiny Ladybug offers to take the thank-you, lifts her red spotted shell and finds her thin wings folded underneath — and flies.
inspiration: The Ugly Duckling (Andersen), turned: what she needed was hers all along, and she finds it by trying to help a friend.
lesson: Wanting to help can show you what you can do.
learning: A ladybug's thin flying wings are folded under its spotted shell.

en-US.title: Ladybug Flies Up High
en-US.text: Every morning, {bird:enter} {bird:go to branches} Bird sang from his branch, high up in the big tree. {bird:live sing} {sfx:song} Tweedle-dee! Down in the grass, {snail:enter} Snail listened {snail:face happy} and smiled. {snail:live talk} "I'd love to say thank you," he said. {snail:face sad} [slowly] "But that branch is so high, it would take me all week." {ladybug:enter} {ladybug:go to snail} Ladybug had heard. {ladybug:hop} "I'll take your thank-you up!" But… how? She couldn't climb that high either. {ladybug:live think} She thought, and thought. [short pause] Then something under her shell gave a little flutter. {ladybug:live wings hold} She lifted her red shell with its six black spots — and underneath, folded up, were two thin wings! {ladybug:sparkle} [gasps] "Wings! My own wings!" {snail:face surprised} Snail's eyes went wide. {ladybug:live wings resume} {sfx:flutter} Ladybug fluttered them once… twice… {ladybug:face happy} {ladybug:go to bird by fly} and UP she flew, all the way to Bird. [excited] "Thank you for your song — from Snail!" {bird:face happy} {bird:hearts} Bird looked down at Snail. Then he {bird:live sing} sang his very best song, just for him. {snail:face happy} {snail:hearts} [happily] And Snail heard every note.

es-ES.title: Mariquita vuela muy alto
es-ES.text: Cada mañana, {bird:enter} {bird:go to branches} Pájaro cantaba en su rama, allá arriba, en el árbol grande. {bird:live sing} {sfx:song} ¡Pío, pío, piruí! Abajo, entre la hierba, {snail:enter} Caracol lo escuchaba {snail:face happy} con una sonrisa. {snail:live talk} —Me gustaría darle las gracias —dijo—. {snail:face sad} [slowly] Pero esa rama está tan alta que tardaría una semana en subir. {ladybug:enter} {ladybug:go to snail} Mariquita lo había oído todo. {ladybug:hop} —¡Yo se las llevo! Pero… ¿cómo? Ella tampoco podía trepar tan alto. {ladybug:live think} Pensó y pensó. [short pause] Y entonces notó un cosquilleo bajo el caparazón. {ladybug:live wings hold} Levantó su caparazón rojo de seis lunares negros… ¡y debajo, bien dobladas, había dos alas finitas! {ladybug:sparkle} [gasps] —¡Alas! ¡Tengo alas! {snail:face surprised} A Caracol se le pusieron los ojos como platos. {ladybug:live wings resume} {sfx:flutter} Mariquita las batió una vez… dos veces… {ladybug:face happy} {ladybug:go to bird by fly} ¡y subió volando hasta Pájaro! [excited] —¡Gracias por tu canción, de parte de Caracol! {bird:face happy} {bird:hearts} Pájaro miró a Caracol, allá abajo, y {bird:live sing} le cantó su canción más bonita, solo para él. {snail:face happy} {snail:hearts} [happily] Y Caracol no se perdió ni una nota.

ja-JP.title: テントウムシさん、とんだ！
ja-JP.text: まいあさ、{bird:enter}{bird:go to branches}ことりは、大きな木のたかいえだでうたいます。{bird:live sing}{sfx:song}ピピピ、ピルルー！したのくさでは、{snail:enter}カタツムリくんがきいて、{snail:face happy}にっこり。{snail:live talk}「ありがとうって、いいたいな」 {snail:face sad}[slowly]「でも、あんなにたかいところ…いっしゅうかんかかっちゃう」 {ladybug:enter}{ladybug:go to snail}きいていたのは、テントウムシさん。{ladybug:hop}「わたしが、とどけてあげる！」 でも…どうやって？テントウムシさんも、のぼれません。{ladybug:live think}うーん、うーん。[short pause]そのとき、せなかで、なにかがぴくぴくっ。{ladybug:live wings hold}くろいてんてんがむっつの赤いせなかを、ぱかっとひらくと——うすいはねが二まい、たたんであったのです！{ladybug:sparkle}[gasps]「はね！わたしのはね！」 {snail:face surprised}カタツムリくんは、目をまんまる。{ladybug:live wings resume}{sfx:flutter}はねを、いちど…にど…ぱたぱた。{ladybug:face happy}{ladybug:go to bird by fly}そして、たかーく、ことりのところまで！[excited]「カタツムリくんから、うたのおれいです！」 {bird:face happy}{bird:hearts}ことりは、したのカタツムリくんを見て、{bird:live sing}いちばんすてきなうたを、カタツムリくんのためだけにうたいました。{snail:face happy}{snail:hearts}[happily]カタツムリくんには、ぜんぶの音が、ちゃんときこえましたよ。

de-DE.title: Der Marienkäfer fliegt hinauf
de-DE.text: {bird:enter} {bird:go to branches} Der Vogel sang jeden Morgen auf seinem Ast, hoch oben im großen Baum. {bird:live sing} {sfx:song} Tirili, tirila! Unten im Gras lauschte {snail:enter} die Schnecke {snail:face happy} und lächelte. {snail:live talk} „Ich würde ihm so gern Danke sagen“, sagte sie. {snail:face sad} [slowly] „Aber der Ast ist so hoch… bis ich da oben bin, ist die ganze Woche um.“ {ladybug:enter} {ladybug:go to snail} Der Marienkäfer hatte alles gehört. {ladybug:hop} „Ich bringe dein Dankeschön hinauf!“ Aber… wie? So hoch konnte er auch nicht klettern. {ladybug:live think} Er dachte nach und dachte nach. [short pause] Da kribbelte etwas unter seinem Panzer. {ladybug:live wings hold} Er hob den roten Panzer mit den sechs schwarzen Punkten – und darunter lagen, fein zusammengefaltet, zwei dünne Flügel! {ladybug:sparkle} [gasps] „Flügel! Meine eigenen Flügel!“ {snail:face surprised} Die Schnecke machte große Augen. {ladybug:live wings resume} {sfx:flutter} Der Marienkäfer flatterte einmal… zweimal… {ladybug:face happy} {ladybug:go to bird by fly} und HOCH flog er, bis ganz hinauf zum Vogel. [excited] „Danke für dein Lied – von der Schnecke!“ {bird:face happy} {bird:hearts} Der Vogel schaute hinunter zur Schnecke. Dann {bird:live sing} sang er sein allerschönstes Lied, nur für sie. {snail:face happy} {snail:hearts} [happily] Und die Schnecke hörte jeden einzelnen Ton.

fr-FR.title: Coccinelle vole tout là-haut
fr-FR.text: Chaque matin, {bird:enter} {bird:go to branches} Oiseau chantait sur sa branche, tout en haut du grand arbre. {bird:live sing} {sfx:song} Tiri-li, tiri-lou ! En bas, dans l’herbe, {snail:enter} Escargot écoutait {snail:face happy} en souriant. {snail:live talk} « J’aimerais tant lui dire merci, a-t-il dit. {snail:face sad} [slowly] Mais cette branche est si haute… il me faudrait toute la semaine pour y monter. » {ladybug:enter} {ladybug:go to snail} Coccinelle avait tout entendu. {ladybug:hop} « Ton merci, je vais le lui porter, moi ! » Mais… comment ? Elle non plus ne savait pas grimper si haut. {ladybug:live think} Elle a réfléchi, réfléchi. [short pause] Et puis quelque chose a frémi sous sa carapace. {ladybug:live wings hold} Elle a soulevé sa carapace rouge à six points noirs — et dessous, bien pliées, il y avait deux ailes toutes fines ! {ladybug:sparkle} [gasps] « Des ailes ! J’ai des ailes à moi ! » {snail:face surprised} Escargot a ouvert de grands yeux. {ladybug:live wings resume} {sfx:flutter} Coccinelle les a battues une fois… deux fois… {ladybug:face happy} {ladybug:go to bird by fly} et elle s’est envolée, tout là-haut, jusqu’à Oiseau ! [excited] « Merci pour ta chanson — de la part d’Escargot ! » {bird:face happy} {bird:hearts} Oiseau a regardé Escargot, tout en bas. Puis il {bird:live sing} a chanté sa plus belle chanson, rien que pour lui. {snail:face happy} {snail:hearts} [happily] Et Escargot n’en a pas perdu une seule note.

it-IT.title: Coccinella vola in alto
it-IT.text: Ogni mattina, {bird:enter} {bird:go to branches} Uccellino cantava dal suo ramo, in alto sul grande albero. {bird:live sing} {sfx:song} Cirilì, cirilò! Giù nell'erba, {snail:enter} Chiocciola ascoltava {snail:face happy} e sorrideva. {snail:live talk} «Vorrei tanto dirgli grazie», ha detto. {snail:face sad} [slowly] «Ma quel ramo è così in alto che ci metterei una settimana.» {ladybug:enter} {ladybug:go to snail} Coccinella aveva sentito tutto. {ladybug:hop} «Il tuo grazie lo porto su io!» Ma… come? Neanche lei sapeva arrampicarsi fin lassù. {ladybug:live think} Ha pensato e ripensato. [short pause] Poi, sotto la corazza, qualcosa ha fatto un piccolo fremito. {ladybug:live wings hold} Ha sollevato la sua corazza rossa con i sei puntini neri… e sotto, ben ripiegate, c'erano due ali sottili! {ladybug:sparkle} [gasps] «Ali! Ho le ali!» {snail:face surprised} Chiocciola ha sgranato gli occhi. {ladybug:live wings resume} {sfx:flutter} Coccinella le ha sbattute una volta… due volte… {ladybug:face happy} {ladybug:go to bird by fly} ed è volata SU, fino a Uccellino. [excited] «Grazie per la tua canzone, da parte di Chiocciola!» {bird:face happy} {bird:hearts} Uccellino ha guardato giù, verso Chiocciola. Poi {bird:live sing} ha cantato la sua canzone più bella, tutta per lei. {snail:face happy} {snail:hearts} [happily] E Chiocciola ha sentito ogni nota.

zh-TW.title: 瓢蟲飛得高高的
zh-TW.text: 每天早上，{bird:enter}{bird:go to branches}小鳥都站在大樹高高的樹枝上唱歌。{bird:live sing}{sfx:song}啾啾啾，啾哩啾！下面的草叢裡，{snail:enter}蝸牛聽著聽著，{snail:face happy}笑了。{snail:live talk}「我好想跟牠說聲謝謝。」 牠說。{snail:face sad}[slowly]「可是牠在好高好高的地方，我要爬一整個星期，才爬得上去。」 {ladybug:enter}{ladybug:go to snail}瓢蟲聽到了。{ladybug:hop}「我幫你把謝謝送上去！」 可是……要怎麼送呢？瓢蟲也爬不了那麼高呀。{ladybug:live think}牠想呀想，想呀想。[short pause]這時，牠的殼底下，好像有什麼東西輕輕動了一下。{ladybug:live wings hold}牠掀起紅紅的、有六個黑點點的殼——殼底下，摺得好好的，是兩片薄薄的翅膀！{ladybug:sparkle}[gasps]「翅膀！我自己的翅膀！」 {snail:face surprised}蝸牛的眼睛睜得好大好大。{ladybug:live wings resume}{sfx:flutter}瓢蟲拍一下翅膀……再拍一下……{ladybug:face happy}{ladybug:go to bird by fly}咻——飛上去了，一路飛到小鳥身邊！[excited]「謝謝你的歌！這是蝸牛要我說的！」 {bird:face happy}{bird:hearts}小鳥低頭看看蝸牛。然後，牠{bird:live sing}唱了一首最好聽的歌，專門唱給蝸牛聽。{snail:face happy}{snail:hearts}[happily]每一個音，蝸牛都聽到了。

zh-HK.title: 瓢蟲飛高高
zh-HK.text: 每天早上，{bird:enter}{bird:go to branches}小鳥都站在大樹高高的樹枝上唱歌。{bird:live sing}{sfx:song}吱吱啾，吱吱喳！草叢裏，{snail:enter}蝸牛聽着聽着，{snail:face happy}笑了起來。{snail:live talk}「我好想多謝佢。」 牠說。{snail:face sad}[slowly]「不過佢喺咁高嘅地方，我要爬足成個禮拜先上到去。」 {ladybug:enter}{ladybug:go to snail}瓢蟲聽到了。{ladybug:hop}「等我幫你送個多謝上去！」 可是……怎樣送呢？瓢蟲也爬不到那麼高。{ladybug:live think}牠想了又想。[short pause]這時，殼底下好像有甚麼輕輕地拍了一下。{ladybug:live wings hold}牠掀起有六粒黑點的紅色硬殼——下面原來摺着兩片薄薄的翅膀！{ladybug:sparkle}[gasps]「翼呀！我自己都有翼！」 {snail:face surprised}蝸牛的眼睛瞪得大大的。{ladybug:live wings resume}{sfx:flutter}瓢蟲拍一下翅膀……再拍一下……{ladybug:face happy}{ladybug:go to bird by fly}呼的一聲飛起來，一直飛到小鳥身邊！[excited]「多謝你嘅歌！係蝸牛叫我嚟講㗎！」 {bird:face happy}{bird:hearts}小鳥低頭看看蝸牛。接着，牠{bird:live sing}唱出自己最拿手的歌，只唱給蝸牛一個聽。{snail:face happy}{snail:hearts}[happily]每一個音，蝸牛都聽得清清楚楚。

song.prompt: a small songbird singing a bright, cheerful morning song, realistic field recording

flutter.prompt: tiny insect wings fluttering, very light and quick, close
